scope: all same-name variants in corrected UI/item/template intersection
primary_review: Sol directly reviewed fixed Git objects, all tier overrides, actual template bindings, execution-chain applicability and the current player examples.

collaboration.delegation_scope: one separate blessing group: Man-Stopper; three different blessings in parallel

findings: Player text correctly states that each pellet has its own cleave budget and that all pellets in the shot share that shot's critical state. It does not claim that every pellet independently consumes hit mass from every target.
The technical prose describes per-pellet budget initialization and per-target damage aggregation. This matches the fixed-SHA consumer and does not assert a per-pellet, per-target hit-mass decrement.

The cache guard suppresses subsequent HitMass.consume_hit_mass calls for a hit unit already indexed during the same shot. The stop-data lookup at lines 552-557 uses unit_damage_data[num_unit_damage_index], where num_unit_damage_index is the current global index, rather than indexing through unit_to_damage_data_index[hit_unit]. The current page does not claim that a target-specific cached stop result is reused, so this source nuance does not require a page correction.

Tier values, additive same-stage stagger example, special-shell model/mode distinctions, switching behavior, localization hash pairing, exact mapping, and outside-candidate boundaries are consistent with the inspected evidence.

pellet_review.player_wording: 每顆彈丸有自己的順劈預算；同一發射擊的彈丸共用該次射擊的暴擊狀態。
pellet_review.verified_behavior: ActionShootPellets creates a fresh attack and impact mass budget for each saved pellet. Within one shot, the per-unit index is retained across the pellet loop; a later pellet hitting an already indexed unit skips HitMass.consume_hit_mass. The unit map is reset after that shot's hit processing.
pellet_review.stop_lookup_caveat: The later branch consults unit_damage_data[num_unit_damage_index].stopped; num_unit_damage_index is the current global array index, and the code does not use unit_to_damage_data_index[hit_unit] as the lookup index. Avoid describing this as guaranteed reuse of that same target's stored stop result.
pellet_review.formal_text_assessment: README.md and technical notes state that budgets are created per pellet but do not say each pellet separately consumes hit mass for every target or that a target-specific cached stop is reused. No correction required.

refs.meaning: Pellets are fired and hit processing starts once the shell's pellets have been collected.
Per-shot unit damage and unit-index cache are cleared after hit processing.
Each saved-pellet iteration initializes its own attack and impact mass budgets.
HitMass.consume_hit_mass runs only when the unit is not already in unit_to_damage_data_index.
Damage is scaled by the number of pellets that hit the unit and uses the shot-level critical flag.
New unit result and stopped flag are stored; the later indexed-unit branch reads the stopped flag using the current num_unit_damage_index.
